spec_match.rationale: Exercises the WGSL language-extension opt-in mechanism exactly: requires buffer_view; compiled through the real adapter→device→createShaderModule→getCompilationInfo chain, with a validation error scope around the compile.

interactive.rationale: The button runs the full real chain each time; step results and verbatim compiler messages render live.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises real compilation with the engine's actual messages; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles navigator.gpu absent, null adapter (with the registry cross-reference so the visitor still gets an answer), device failure, and flags registry/compile disagreement as reportable.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5094091886034944; page links the proposal syntax.

conformance.rationale: The suite's requires-directive-gates-compilation assertion is this page's chain as a self-contained check, with the on-GPU agreement kept manual.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: requestAdapter() genuinely returned null in this GPU-less sandbox and the page reported that honestly with the registry answer inlined; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read. The compile path itself needs GPU hardware and is not claimed.

telemetry_health.rationale: Separate asserts for no-adapter and compiled/rejected outcomes including registry agreement.

design_system.rationale: Step results emerald/rose on paper (AA); message log on stone; CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Steps are labelled rows; messages are a role=log aria-live region; native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Step rows wrap; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Run the compile chain on real GPU hardware
openQuestions.detail: This sandbox has no adapter, so steps 2–3 are unreachable. On hardware: pre-153 the compile must be rejected with a requires-directive error; on Chrome 153 it must pass — and either way must agree with the registry.

guidanceConsulted.query: step progress list live results screen reader
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Represent chains as labelled text steps with announced results.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Three step rows with textual results plus an aria-live message log.

guidanceConsulted.query: step rows compiler messages wrapping mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap long compiler messages inside their own bordered block.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Message log uses pre-wrap + overflow-wrap; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the chain runs and honestly stops at the null adapter in this GPU-less sandbox, cross-referencing the registry so the visitor still gets the language-feature answer. Hardware verification of the compile outcomes is the open question.
